fields.letterText:
Every {0} colonist feels a wave of anxiety and anger!

Some distant engine of hatred is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit worse.

The drone level is {1}.
fields.label: psychic drone
fields.description: A distant archotech is emitting psychic signals through an orbital amplifier, driving people towards insanity.

fields.letterText:
Every {0} colonist smiles with contentment!

Some distant engine of happiness is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit better.
fields.label: psychic soothe
fields.description: A distant archotech is emitting psychic signals through an orbital amplifier, calming people and stabilizing their minds.

fields.letterText: A psychic droner machine has begun affecting this region.
fields.label: psychic droner
fields.description: A psychic droner tuned to the {0} gender is driving {0}s mad.

fields.letterText: A psychic suppressor field has begun reducing the consciousness of {0}s across the whole region. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
fields.label: psychic suppression
fields.description: A psychic suppression field is affecting {0}s and reducing their consciousness. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.

fields.letterText:
A large piece of an ancient ship has crashed nearby.

Your colonists can feel it in the back of their mind, exhorting unspeakable acts. It must have an onboard machine persona with psychic projection ability. And this persona is not friendly.

Destroy it as soon as possible. But beware - it will probably defend itself.
fields.label: ship part crash (psychic)
